request-prompt: Move the 'Product Reviews & Deals' list and the 'Sponsored Content' section further up the page, perhaps alongside the primary weather forecast, to make those articles easier to find.
goal: I am open to clicking on sponsored content recommendation widgets, often finding the recommended listicles, product deals, and external articles interesting to read.
jobs: I want to search for a specific city or zip code to check its current temperature and forecast.
I want to check the hourly or 10-day forecast to plan my upcoming activities and decide what to wear.
I want to view the interactive radar map to see if rain or storms are heading toward my current location.
I want to read weather-related news and watch top story videos to stay informed about extreme weather events.
I want to get safety tips and information on seasonal health concerns, such as tick safety or high-heat warnings, to protect my well-being.
I want to read product reviews and deals for weather-appropriate gear, such as sunscreen or sun shirts, to make an informed purchase.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer raw data, interactive charts, and highly detailed technical metrics over articles or narrative summaries when searching for information.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer consuming information through short video clips and narrative summaries rather than analyzing complex charts, numbers, and interactive maps.

preference-pairs.a: I am strictly task-focused when using utility websites; I look for the specific information I need, get out quickly, and ignore all peripheral articles or lifestyle pieces.
preference-pairs.b: I enjoy browsing peripheral content, lifestyle tips, and trending stories, often staying on a website to read other articles even when I came for a quick, specific update.

preference-pairs.a: I actively avoid and ignore sponsored content recommendations and native advertising because I find them highly distracting and untrustworthy.
preference-pairs.b: I am open to clicking on sponsored content recommendation widgets, often finding the recommended listicles, product deals, and external articles interesting to read.

preference: I am open to clicking on sponsored content recommendation widgets, often finding the recommended listicles, product deals, and external articles interesting to read.
